claims.statement: ARDoCo's pipeline is a three-level composite: AbstractExecutionStage extends Pipeline and holds PipelineAgents, PipelineAgent extends Pipeline and holds Informants, and Pipeline.process() executes its added steps strictly sequentially — a stage runs its agents one after another and each agent runs its informants one after another (depth-first).

Every pipeline component shares the AbstractPipelineStep lifecycle: run() calls before(), then process(), then after(); Pipeline sets a finished flag in after() (exposed via hasFinished()) and logs the wall-clock duration of each child step.

Pipeline components communicate only through the shared DataRepository blackboard: it stores PipelineStepData in a sorted map keyed by String id, getData(id, class) returns an Optional that is empty for unknown ids or failed casts, addData overwrites with a logged warning, and every AbstractPipelineStep holds the same repository instance instead of references to other steps.

Stages gate agents and agents gate informants at run time: AbstractExecutionStage declares @Configurable @ChildClassConfigurable List<String> enabledAgents (defaulting to all constructor-provided agent ids) and adds only matching agents in preparePipelineSteps(); PipelineAgent does the same for enabledInformants in initialize().

Stages and agents initialize their state during preparation, not construction: AbstractExecutionStage.preparePipelineSteps() (final) invokes the abstract initializeState() before adding agents — e.g. TextExtraction creates and stores its TextStateImpl if absent — while PipelineAgent.initialize() invokes a default no-op initializeState() before adding informants.

AbstractConfigurable applies configuration by reflection over the class hierarchy: fields annotated @Configurable are matched by key — default '<SimpleClassName>::<fieldName>', overridable via @Configurable(key=...), and with @ChildClassConfigurable the concrete subclass name replaces the declaring class name (combining both on a field throws) — @NoConfiguration skips a class level; supported value types are Integer, Double, Boolean, enums by constant name, and comma-separated List<String>, everything else is rejected.

ConfigurationHelper.loadAdditionalConfigs(File) parses UTF-8 files with one 'KEY::attribute=VALUE' line per entry (blank lines skipped, malformed lines logged, a non-existing file throws IllegalArgumentException), and getDefaultConfigurationOptions() reflects over all concrete non-test AbstractConfigurable subclasses under edu.kit.kastel.mcse.ardoco to instantiate each and record every @Configurable field's default value as a string (duplicates throw).

Configuration flows down the same composite that executes steps: each Pipeline re-applies its last applied configuration to child steps in preparePipelineSteps(), stages additionally apply it to all agents, agents to all informants, and stage/agent static factories (e.g. TextExtraction.get(additionalConfigs, dataRepository)) construct the component and then call applyConfiguration.

The ArchUnit rule configurableFieldsOnlyInConfigurableClasses in BasicArchitectureTest enforces that @Configurable fields may only be declared in classes assignable to AbstractConfigurable, so reflection-based configuration cannot escape the framework.

Ardoco is the pipeline entry point: it extends Pipeline with id "ARDoCo", creates its own DataRepository, seeds it with ProjectPipelineDataImpl carrying the project name, and runAndSave(outputDir) returns null when no steps were added, otherwise runs the pipeline, wraps the repository in an ArdocoResult, and saves outputs before returning the result.

runAndSave writes three output kinds into the output directory via FilePrinter: traceLinks_<project>.txt (human-readable trace links), inconsistencyDetection_<project>.txt, and per-type CSVs (sadSamTlr_, samCodeTlr_, sadCodeTlr_ prefixed with the project name) that are only written when that link type is non-empty.

ArdocoRunner owns an isSetUp flag and a nullable output directory: final run() returns an ArdocoResult only when isSetUp() is true AND an output directory was set, otherwise it logs an error and returns null; final runWithoutSaving() requires only isSetUp(), runs the pipeline, and returns the raw DataRepository without writing files; concrete runners (e.g. Arcotl, InconsistencyDetection) add steps in setUp(...), call the protected setOutputDirectory(...), then flip isSetUp = true.

AnonymousRunner performs setup eagerly in its constructor: setUp() fetches the Ardoco data repository, calls the abstract initializePipelineSteps(dataRepository) (which typically loads input data and may throw IOException), adds every returned AbstractPipelineStep to Ardoco, and returns true — an IOException sets isSetUp to false.

ArdocoResult is the public typed read API over the DataRepository: a record exposing project name, Text, metamodels, models, trace links (getArchitectureTraceLinks, getSamCodeTraceLinks, getSadCodeTraceLinks) and inconsistencies; per-metamodel and per-ArtemisTarget state accessors (getConnectionState, getInconsistencyState, getCodeTraceabilityState, getArtemisConnectionState, getArtemisInconsistencyState) log a warning and return null when the corresponding state container is missing (derived accessors then yield empty collections), whereas getPreprocessingData(), getSimplePreprocessingData(), and getText() throw when preprocessing never ran.

The SAM intermediate model is metamodel-independent: sealed ArchitectureItem permits ArchitectureComponent, ArchitectureInterface, and ArchitectureMethod; components hold subcomponents plus provided/required interfaces and a type, interfaces hold ArchitectureMethod signatures; ArchitectureModelWithComponentsAndInterfaces accepts only component/interface roots and returns them as trace-link endpoints. PCM/UML/component-listing extractors (e.g. PcmExtractor) produce it.

ArchitectureModel.createArchitectureModelDto() flattens the component/interface/method tree into an id-keyed ArchitectureModelDto: ArchitectureItemRepository holds the sorted map of id → item DTO plus the root content id list; the sealed ArchitectureItemDto permits ComponentDto, InterfaceDto, MethodDto (JSON-discriminated by a 'type' property); each DTO stores children only as id sets (subcomponentsIds, providedInterfacesIds, requiredInterfacesIds, methodSignaturesIds); ArchitectureMethod has a (name, id) constructor so deserialized methods keep their identifier.

ArchitectureExtractor.writeOutArchitectureModel(model, file) serializes an ArchitectureModel to the conventional .aam file name (architectureModel.aam) via JsonHandling.createObjectMapper() and createArchitectureModelDto(); no main-source code path reads an ArchitectureModelDto back into an ArchitectureModel, so the .aam output is currently a write-only cache/export artifact.

The code model is a repository-backed tree: sealed CodeItem permits CodeModule (CodeAssembly, CodeCompilationUnit, CodePackage), ComputationalObject (ControlElement), and Datatype (ClassUnit, InterfaceUnit); every item registers itself in an id-keyed CodeItemRepository, relationships and content are stored as id lists resolved via getCodeItemsByIds, and the model is rooted by CodeModelWithCompilationUnits or CodeModelWithCompilationUnitsAndPackages — selected by Metamodel.CODE_WITH_COMPILATION_UNITS[_AND_PACKAGES] — each holding the repository, root content ids, and a list of CodeFiles (CodeEntity, not CodeItem).

Datatype and ControlElement carry 1-indexed, inclusive startLine/endLine source ranges serialized via @JsonProperty and defaulting to -1 when unknown; extractors populate them (the JDT JavaModel derives them from CompilationUnit.getLineNumber of the declaration start and of start+length, and passes them into the ClassUnit/InterfaceUnit/ControlElement constructors).

Content ownership in the code model lives on the sealed Datatype base, which stores the content id list and provides getContent(), getContentIds() (via @JsonGetter("content")), and getAllDataTypes(), plus compilationUnitId/parentDatatypeId and extended/implemented/datatype-reference id lists; ClassUnit and InterfaceUnit only add type-specific constructors including (content, startLine, endLine) variants.

Model ids survive serialization: Model has a protected Model(String id) constructor where a null id falls back to IdentifierProvider.createId(), CodeModel.CodeModelDto carries the model id alongside the CodeItemRepository, content ids, and code files, and CodeModelWithCompilationUnits(dto)/CodeModelWithCompilationUnitsAndPackages(dto) rebuild a model that retains its original id.

Identity in the code model follows the relationship fields: equals/hashCode of Datatype include compilationUnitId, parentDatatypeId, startLine, endLine, extended/implemented/datatype-reference ids, and content; ControlElement adds startLine/endLine and calleeNames; CodeCompilationUnit adds pathElements, extension, language, and importedModuleNames — so deserialized instances stay identity-stable.

The code model records module imports and function callees: CodeCompilationUnit and CodeAssembly expose getImportedModuleNames() as @JsonProperty-serialized List<String> fields defaulting to empty, ControlElement exposes getCalleeNames() the same way, and CodeCompilationUnit.fromRelativePath(...) derives name, pathElements, and extension from a forward-slash relative path while accepting the import list (used by the Python3 mapper, whereas the Java mappers assemble constructor arguments directly).

Four language backends are wired for code extraction: AllLanguagesExtractor — the code extractor instantiated by the only main-source factory, CodeConfiguration.extractors() in DIRECTORY mode — maps ProgrammingLanguage.JAVA to the Eclipse-JDT JavaExtractor, ProgrammingLanguage.SHELL to ShellExtractor, ProgrammingLanguage.PYTHON to the ANTLR-based Python3Extractor, and ProgrammingLanguage.CPP to CppExtractor; the ANTLR4 Java extractor and mappers under generators/antlr exist and populate the same fields, but no main-source wiring references them (they are exercised by tests only).

The wired JDT-based JavaModel populates the cross-element code-model fields: extractImportedModuleNames reads each import declaration's fully-qualified name into the CodeCompilationUnit's importedModuleNames, and an ASTVisitor over each method declaration collects MethodInvocation identifiers and ClassInstanceCreation type names as the ControlElement's calleeNames.

Code models round-trip end-to-end: CodeExtractor.writeOutCodeModel serializes createCodeModelDto() to codeModel.acm next to the code directory, and readInCodeModel(file, metamodel) deserializes the CodeModelDto and reconstructs the matching CodeModel subclass (triggering CodeItemRepository.init() to re-register items).

All extracted models are stored in a single ModelStates PipelineStepData (ID "ModelStatesData") keyed by Metamodel, added by ModelProviderInformant after extraction (also for models read from an .acm file); ArdocoResult and stage states resolve models and per-metamodel state through these keys.

The Text intermediate representation preserves the NLP annotations downstream stages rely on: Text exposes sentences and words, Sentence exposes phrases, and Word exposes POS tag, lemma, and incoming/outgoing dependency words by DependencyTag; PreprocessingData (ID "PreprocessingData") carries the preprocessed Text in the repository, and NlpInformant is the abstract Informant that supplies annotated texts.

All model elements descend from the sealed Entity (id + name, Serializable, IdentifierProvider-generated ids): Entity permits TextEntity and ModelEntity, and ModelEntity permits ArchitectureEntity and CodeEntity; ModelEntity adds getType()/getTypeParts() used for name/type-based matching in trace linking.

Each pipeline stage communicates through well-known state identifiers in the repository: TextState, ConnectionStates, RecommendationStates, InconsistencyStates, NerConnectionStates, and CodeTraceabilityState declare String ID constants; the model-dependent stages use per-Metamodel container states (ConnectionStates/RecommendationStates/InconsistencyStates) that resolve the state for a metamodel, and ArdocoResult reads them through the same IDs.

The ArchUnit layeredArchitecture rule in ArchitectureTest enforces ten layers (Common, TextExtractor, ModelExtractor, RecommendationGenerator, ConnectionGenerator, Artemis, InconsistencyDetection, CodeTraceability, Pipeline, Execution) with explicit may-only-be-accessed-by rules, plus ordering rules: no dependency on ..execution.. outside execution/tests, Model only after model extraction, *Link classes only after connection generation and named Link only in tracelink/codetraceability/connectiongenerator packages, and Inconsistency classes only after inconsistency detection.

BasicArchitectureTest enforces cross-cutting structure rules: @Configurable fields only in AbstractConfigurable subclasses, TraceLink subclasses must be final, only JsonHandling may construct or configure Jackson mappers (constructor plus builder/shared/rebuild), no classes under edu.kit.kastel.mcse.ardoco may depend on Jackson 2 core/databind (Jackson 3 tools.jackson only, shared annotations excepted), only Environment may call System.getenv, no forEach/forEachOrdered on streams/lists, and interface methods must not use raw java.util collection types outside ..metrics.. (Eclipse Collections preferred).

DeterministicArdocoTest enforces determinism: classes not annotated @Deterministic (and outside ..tests../..metrics../..magika..) must not access Set/Map types or factories (HashSet, HashMap, Eclipse Sets/Maps etc.), HashMap/HashSet are banned in favor of linked versions outside tests, @NoHashCodeEquals classes must not implement equals/hashCode, Comparable implementors need both equals and hashCode, and sorted collection fields/returns must be parameterized with Comparable types.

The CoreNLP ConfigManager singleton loads config.properties and defaults to microserviceUrl=http://localhost:8080, nlpProviderSource=local, corenlpService=/stanfordnlp, healthService=/stanfordnlp/health when loading fails; the MICROSERVICE_URL and NLP_PROVIDER_SOURCE environment variables (read via the Environment utility) override the properties when set.

TextProcessor.processText uses the CoreNLP microservice only when nlpProviderSource is 'microservice' AND MicroserviceChecker.isMicroserviceAvailable() (authenticated GET on the health endpoint must answer exactly 'Microservice is healthy'); IOExceptions and JacksonExceptions are retried up to MAX_FAILED_SERVICE_REQUESTS = 2, conversion failures (NotConvertableException/InvalidJsonException) fall back immediately, and all fallback paths use TextProcessorLocal (embedded Stanford CoreNLP).

TextProcessorService URL-encodes the input text (UTF-8), wraps it in a {json body of the form {text: <encoded>}, sends an authenticated POST to microserviceUrl+corenlpService, and converts the JSON response via textprovider-json's JsonConverter.fromJsonString and DtoToObjectConverter.convertText.

The Metamodel enum distinguishes ARCHITECTURE_WITH_COMPONENTS, ARCHITECTURE_WITH_COMPONENTS_AND_INTERFACES, CODE_WITH_COMPILATION_UNITS, and CODE_WITH_COMPILATION_UNITS_AND_PACKAGES; ModelStates (ID 'ModelStatesData') stores one Model per Metamodel in a sorted map; ModelFormat enumerates supported input formats PCM, UML, COMPONENT_LISTING, and ACM.

DataRepositorySyncer is the sanctioned cross-state synchronization hook: onNounMappingDeletion propagates noun-mapping deletions into every per-metamodel RecommendationState found in the DataRepository.

applyConfiguration(ImmutableSortedMap<String,String>) reflects over the class hierarchy (stopping at Object/AbstractConfigurable, skipping classes annotated @NoConfiguration), applies values for matching keys, then delegates the same map to child components via delegateApplyConfigurationToInternalObjects; the default key is <SimpleClassName>::<fieldName> (custom via @Configurable(key=...)), and @ChildClassConfigurable keys use the concrete subclass name — combining both annotations on one field throws.
AbstractConfigurable supports only Integer, Double, Boolean, enums (by constant name), and List<String> (comma-separated via LIST_SEPARATOR); any other field type throws IllegalArgumentException.

ConfigurationHelper (pipeline-core) loads file-based additional configs: loadAdditionalConfigs parses UTF-8 files with one KEY=VALUE line each (KEY containing the :: class connector, blank lines skipped, malformed lines logged, a non-existing file rejected), and getDefaultConfigurationOptions reflects over all concrete AbstractConfigurable subclasses under edu.kit.kastel.mcse.ardoco (excluding tests) to record every @Configurable field's default value.

DataRepository is a Serializable TreeMap<String, PipelineStepData>; getData(identifier, clazz) returns an Optional<T> that is empty on a miss (debug-logged) or on a failed cast via PipelineStepData.asPipelineStepData, and addData overwrites existing entries while logging a warning when an identifier is reused.

Pipeline.process() first calls preparePipelineSteps() (which re-applies the last configuration to child steps) and then runs each added AbstractPipelineStep sequentially, logging per-step durations; AbstractExecutionStage.preparePipelineSteps() is final and calls initializeState() before adding only the agents whose id is in the configurable enabledAgents list.

Ardoco extends Pipeline with id 'ARDoCo', seeds ProjectPipelineData into a fresh DataRepository, and runAndSave(outputDir) aborts with an error log and returns null when no steps were added; on success it builds ArdocoResult and writes traceLinks_<project>.txt, inconsistencyDetection_<project>.txt, and per-link-type CSVs via FilePrinter. ArdocoRunner is an abstract wrapper whose final run() requires isSetUp() and a set output directory and whose runWithoutSaving() requires only isSetUp() and returns the raw DataRepository; AnonymousRunner performs setup eagerly in its constructor and reports isSetUp=false on IOException.

JsonHandling is the shared immutable Jackson 3 ObjectMapper factory: createObjectMapper() returns a single shared thread-safe mapper built from JsonFactory.builderWithJackson2Defaults() and configureForJackson2() so the serialized format retains Jackson 2 behavior (property sorting, enum handling, visibility); a second factory method accepts StreamReadConstraints for large payloads, and field-based visibility is configured explicitly (getters/setters disabled, fields and creators visible).

The stage state API exposes plural container states for the ArTEMiS features alongside the per-metamodel ones: ArtemisConnectionStates (ID 'ArtemisConnectionStates', under connectiongenerator/artemis) and ArtemisInconsistencyStates (ID 'ArtemisInconsistencyStates') resolve one state per ArtemisTarget (a Metamodel+NamedEntityType pair); the inconsistency API is split into BaseInconsistencyState (add/get inconsistencies), AbstractInconsistencyState (shared base implementation), and InconsistencyState (adds recommended-instance management), with ArtemisInconsistencyState extending only the base contract — DataRepositoryHelper provides has*/get* accessors for all of these containers.

The CoreNLPProvider informant behind TextPreprocessingAgent provisions the annotated Text: its process() checks DataRepositoryHelper.hasAnnotatedText and, when absent, reads the raw InputTextData from the repository, delegates to TextProcessor, and stores the result under PreprocessingData.ID; TextProcessorLocal builds the Text with the embedded Stanford CoreNLP pipeline (annotators tokenize, ssplit, pos, parse, depparse, lemma with EnhancedPlusPlusDependenciesAnnotation).
